## Overview

This unversioned [[braintree]] webpage, captured 2026-09-16, is an orientation to the Braintree developer guides. It presents the guides as a quick route through the essentials for getting started and directs readers who want workflow customization or API mechanics to the separate reference section. See [[braintree-payment-platform]] for the provider-level product and interaction route.

## Key takeaways

- The page separates guide-level familiarization from the API reference's mechanics; it is a documentation map rather than an implementation specification.
- Basics is the route for fundamental API components and their use.
- Payment Method Types is the route for payment forms the gateway processes and how to accept them. This category description does not establish current method availability or merchant eligibility.
- Tools covers Braintree-created aids for managing and securing payment processing, while Additional Features introduces other gateway products and their possible value. The promotional descriptions do not establish a security property or operational outcome.
- The page does not identify SDK versions, product prerequisites, integration procedures, environment behavior, timing commitments, or operational guarantees; follow the applicable detailed guide and independently versioned implementation evidence for those questions.

quotes.text: The guides are designed to help get you familiarized with the bare necessities, giving you a quick and clean approach to getting up and running. If you’re looking for ways to customize your workflow, or just enjoy breaking things down to build them back up, head to the [reference](/braintree/docs/reference/overview) section to dig into the mechanics of our API.
These guides are designed to help you familiarize yourself with the fundamental components the API offers and how to use them.
This section covers all of the forms of payment our gateway can process, and what to do to accept them.
This section covers the tools that we created to make payment processing both easier to manage and more secure.
Ready for more? The Additional Features guides will introduce you to the other products we offer with our gateway, and how they can help you take your payment processing to the next level.
